title: The Hedgehog Concept
coreMove: Find the narrow concept where capability, economics, and genuine commitment reinforce one another.
sourcePressure: The source centers the three-circle model: what you can be best at, the economic engine, and what you are deeply passionate about, with disciplined noes outside the concept.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: The weak version reduces the Hedgehog Concept to branding, focus, or following passion.

hook: three circles on a whiteboard as the main drama
tryThisNow: draw three circles and pick a dream

exampleSpecs.audience: a clinic owner tempted to add general urgent-care hours
exampleSpecs.stakes: expansion would fill appointments while weakening the clinic's rare strength in post-surgical mobility
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the owner writes referrals per rehab slot on the margin of the urgent-care lease and declines the lease after seeing which engine actually works
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a canine treadmill belt drying beside a folder for an urgent-care lease

exampleSpecs.audience: a studio founder choosing between retail giftware and custom facade tiles
exampleSpecs.stakes: retail demand is flattering but the kiln schedule and margins favor precise architectural work
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the founder pins glaze-failure rates beside margin per kiln firing and cancels a giftware run that everyone liked
exampleSpecs.firstImage: numbered tile samples cooling on a steel rack

exampleSpecs.audience: a co-op director deciding which seed lines to carry
exampleSpecs.stakes: members need a clear economic denominator before passion for soil health becomes scattered advocacy
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the director kneels by the trial tags and changes the dashboard from revenue per bag to net yield per resilient acre
exampleSpecs.firstImage: plastic trial tags rattling in a dry wind over cover-crop stubble

exampleSpecs.audience: a festival board tempted to broaden into celebrity premieres
exampleSpecs.stakes: ticket sales could rise briefly while the festival loses its reason to exist
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the programmer reads the donor offer aloud, then marks which films meet local investigative depth, community draw, and sponsor fit before saying no
exampleSpecs.firstImage: screening lanyards spread beside a donor offer letter

exampleSpecs.audience: a repair-shop owner considering full marine electronics installation
exampleSpecs.stakes: bigger invoices may bury the one diagnostic skill boatyards trust
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the owner reviews three warranty saves and sees that corrosion diagnosis per dock visit, not installation revenue, predicts repeat referrals
exampleSpecs.firstImage: green corrosion dust on a battery terminal under a headlamp

exampleSpecs.audience: a nonprofit director deciding whether to add broad wellness workshops
exampleSpecs.stakes: families need consistent grief follow-up more than the organization needs a wider program menu
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the director crosses wellness workshops off the grant draft after matching trained-volunteer calls to family retention in the first ninety days
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a call schedule held down by a smooth river stone on a quiet desk

skillTargets: test all three circles instead of one attractive strength
spot passion without capability or economics
choose disciplined noes that protect the concept

tryThisNowSpec: Take one attractive opportunity. Write the exact capability it uses, the denominator it improves, and the commitment it deepens. If one line is empty, mark it no for now.

sourceAnchors.name: Hedgehog Concept
sourceAnchors.detail: the source describes it as the intersection of what you can become best at, what drives the economic engine, and what you care about deeply enough to sustain
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: The Hedgehog Concept earns its force only when all three circles keep pointing to the same narrow truth.

sourceAnchors.name: fox-versus-hedgehog contrast
sourceAnchors.detail: the source uses the fox and hedgehog contrast to separate clever strategic variety from coherent concentration
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: The fox can narrate six smart paths; the hedgehog asks which one can carry force.

exampleOpeningDiversity.rule: no more than 2 of the 6 examples may open with the pattern 'At HH:MM, <Name> <verb>s'
exampleOpeningDiversity.requiredOpenings: at least 4 distinct opening devices across the 6 examples
exampleOpeningDiversity.rationale: prevents the timestamp+named-protagonist template from dominating the chapter
